images.title: Dots 4 cm from P
images.purpose: Show that dots all 4 cm from P, found by turning a ruler with its 0 mark on P, form a round curve.
images.composition: Spot P centred, a ruler pointing right from it, and a ring of dots around P, with wide margins.
images.exact_structure: One spot P in the centre marked amber #E69F00. One ruler as a plain thin rectangle from P pointing right, its 0 cm mark exactly on P and its 4 cm mark at the last dot. Exactly 12 teal #0072B2 dots evenly spaced every 30 degrees on a circle of radius 4 cm around P, one dot at the 4 cm mark of the ruler. A faint grey #6B7280 circle through the dots. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a ruler whose 0 mark is not on P
images.takeaway: Every dot is 4 cm from P, so the dots make a round curve.
images.description: A spot P with a ruler from its 0 cm mark to a 4 cm dot and 12 teal dots evenly spaced round P on a faint grey circle.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the 0 mark of the ruler and say where it sits.

image_decisions.why: The ring of equally distant dots is one picture idea.
